text: DSH Turn Navigator 为 DSH 网页端长对话添加轮次导航条，按用户消息显示标记，并随阅读位置高亮当前轮次。用户可悬停或聚焦查看提问文本预览，也可点击标记跳转到对应消息；少于三轮时不显示导航条。插件还会在对话已打开、历史可继续加载且轮数不足时请求补载旧消息。它依赖宿主提供 conversation.chat.navigator 插槽。

DSH Turn Navigator adds a turn rail to long DSH Web chats. It tracks user turns, highlights the turn at the reading position, previews text on hover or keyboard focus, and jumps to a selected message. It appears from three turns onward and requires the host conversation.chat.navigator slot.
想快速回到长聊天里的某条用户消息。
对话很长时，怎么按轮次找到之前的提问？
让 DSH 能从导航标记直接滚动到指定用户轮次。
能不能先预览每一轮的提问内容再决定跳转？
聊天窗口滚动时，我想知道当前读到哪一轮。
DSH 对话轮数变多后怎样显示紧凑的导航？
How can I jump back to an earlier question in a long chat?
Show me which user turn is currently beside my reading position.
DSH Turn Navigator 的功能「轮次标记与跳转」：在侧边显示已加载的用户消息轮次，点击标记滚动到对应消息。用户消息不足三轮时不显示导航条。
DSH Turn Navigator 的功能「轮次预览与当前位置」：滚动时高亮阅读位置对应的轮次，悬停或键盘聚焦标记可查看该轮文本摘要，便于判断要跳到哪里。
DSH Turn Navigator 的功能「补载历史以判断显示条件」：对话已打开、尚未达到三轮且仍有更早历史时，请求加载旧消息；正在加载时不会重复请求。
DSH Turn Navigator 使用前须知：需要宿主提供 conversation.chat.navigator 插槽；README 称所需 SDK 尚未声明。（见 src/client/index.ts:21-26）

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · @deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A compact turn navigator for long DSH Web conversations. It follows the conversation scroll, previews a user turn on hover, and jumps to that turn on click. It stays hidden until the conversation contains at least three user turns.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Preview：It supports keyboard focus, light and dark themes, and reduced-motion preferences. When needed, it loads only enough older history to decide whether the navigator should appear without moving the reader's current position.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Installation：The plugin is private and not published. Its private repository is `dsh-external/dsh-turn-navigator`, but the repository remains empty until the first reviewed push. Use the local installation path until a reviewed commit is available, then start Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w "/path/to/dsh-turn-navigator"
dsh web
```

After the first reviewed commit is pushed, install that exact private revision with:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:dsh-external/dsh-turn-navigator#<reviewed-commit>
```

The checked-in `lib/` output installs without rebuilding. A compatible DSH Web version is required. To remove the plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove -w @deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Required DSH Web slot：This plugin registers into `conversation.chat.navigator`; it does not own or render that slot. A compatible DSH Web build must ship the same contract in both the host runtime and the official private client SDK declarations. A plugin-local type augmentation is not a substitute: it could make TypeScript pass while a host that does not render the slot silently shows no navigator.

Add the slot in the owning `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` package at these points:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Required DSH Web slot：4. Cover declaration and disposal, render dispatch, and anchored older-history loading in the host package tests, then publish a matching private SDK version for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` and its aligned client peers. A source-only host change does not unblock an external plugin that develops only against official registry packages.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Development and verification：The project `.npmrc` selects the private `@deepseek-ai/*` scope; pnpm 11 reads its `${NPM_TOKEN}` authentication mapping from the trusted user-level `~/.npmrc`. The SDK packages are pinned to the reviewed `0.0.1-rc.2` set. Set `NPM_TOKEN`, install without lifecycle scripts, then run the checks:

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run check
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Development and verification：Do not link a DSH source checkout into this directory. Use `pnpm run watch` beside `dsh web --dev` for live browser changes. See [`compat/`](compat/README.md) for the isolated assembled Web fixture.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · Model Experience：None. The plugin only renders existing conversation data in the browser.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-turn-navigator README · KV Cache effect：None.
